blocks.h2: When to Call for Drain Cleaning
blocks.body: Call when a plunger hasn't fixed it, when the same drain keeps clogging or when a drain gives off a sewer smell. Notice how far it spreads. A single slow fixture usually has a clog close by. If the basement floor drain fills when the washer empties or the toilet bubbles when the tub drains, the main line is involved, and that's a job for [sewer rodding](/mchenry/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

bodies: Most household clogs come from hair, soap, grease, food and lint. In McHenry, there's often one more ingredient: mineral scale from hard groundwater. It builds a rough crust inside drain lines that catches everything else.

We clear the clog with a cable sized for the pipe and show you what came out. If the same drain keeps clogging, scale or grease may be coating the whole line, and [hydro jetting](/mchenry/hydro-jetting) cleans it back to the pipe wall.
Grease is the number one cause of kitchen sink clogs. It goes down warm, cools and sticks to the pipe, and food and soap build on top of it.

If both sides of the sink fill or the dishwasher backs up into it, the clog is past the trap. We clear the line all the way to the stack. If the disposal is involved, see [garbage disposal repair](/mchenry/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in McHenry Homes
blocks.intro: Most McHenry homes were built between 1970 and 2009. Their drains clog for a few predictable reasons.

items.body: Groundwater minerals combine with soap scum, especially in showers and tubs. The pipe narrows a little every year.
Homes built for families in the 1990s and 2000s have kitchen lines with decades of grease in them.
When several drains slow down together, it's usually a sag, roots or a blockage in the main. That's [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When every drain slows down at once or water comes up at the basement floor drain, the main sewer drain is blocked. Clearing it takes a machine that can run the full line from the cleanout to the main or the septic tank.

We clear the line, then camera it so you can see the cause. In McHenry, that's often a sag where the line settled, wipes or grease. Repeat clogs get a plan: [sewer line cleaning](/mchenry/sewer-maintenance) on a schedule, [hydro jetting](/mchenry/hydro-jetting) or a [sewer repair](/mchenry/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: Can hard water clog my drains?
items.preview: It contributes. Mineral scale catches hair, soap and grease.
items.answer: It contributes. Hard water leaves mineral deposits inside drain pipes, and those rough surfaces catch hair, soap and grease. Over time the pipe narrows until it clogs.

items.q: Is it one drain or the main line?
items.preview: One slow fixture is local. Several, or the floor drain, is the main.
items.answer: If only one fixture is slow, the clog is probably close to it. If several are slow or water comes up at the floor drain, the main line is involved.

items.q: Do you clean drains for homes on septic?
items.answer: Yes. We clear household drains and the line to the septic tank. If the tank is full, we'll let you know so you can have it pumped.

items.q: Should I use drain cleaner chemicals?
items.answer: We don't recommend them. They can damage pipes and are hard on septic systems. A cable or jetting removes the clog safely.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the clog. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. We give you a flat price before any work begins.
